gbv7879.name: Annual Fact Sheet on Gender-Based Violence, FY 2078/79 (July/Aug 2021 to June/July 2022), English version
gbv7879.publisher: Nepal Police Headquarters, Crime Investigation Department, Women, Children and Senior Citizen Service Directorate
gbv7879.notes: Only homicide-related category in the fact sheet is 'Murder after Rape' (registered cases). Province table (page 1) and district map labels (page 3) both extracted with pdftotext -layout; the 6 districts sum to 9 and agree with the province table (Province 1 2 = Morang 2; Madhesh 2 = Bara 1 + Sarlahi 1; Gandaki 1 = Tanahun; Karnali 3 = Surkhet; Sudurpashchim 1 = Darchula). The district map shows only districts with cases; districts not labelled are not given as zero here. The same page also gives victim/offender age breakdowns for the national total only (not included). Bagmati excluding the Valley and the Valley police area have no matching shape (they split ADM1 Bagmati). Province 1 = Koshi; Madhesh = geoBoundaries 'Province 2'. This counts only murders that followed rape - it is NOT total homicide.
